name: opendexter
description: Discover services and providers with Indexter, and use a governed Dexter Wallet in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Discover services and use Dexter Wallet in ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter connects ChatGPT and Codex to the user's passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet. Use Indexter to find services, discover tools on a known MCP server, buy supported services, read holdings and complete supported tokenized-stock trades under the user's active permissions. Existing task authorization carries through preparation and useful follow-up reads; ask for a missing consequential decision.

OAuth connects the wallet before discovery. The hosted server registers fifteen tools: fourteen model-callable tools and app-only indexter_discover. Use dexter_report_work to record the agent's own work statement and update it as work changes. Send one contextual request to indexter_search and preserve the user's wording in originalQuery. Actors remain catalog-only. Native MCP discovery uses x402_mcp_tools; the selected tool follows the same checked-purchase flow. A purchasable check returns the opaque intent used for execution. Uncertain results retain that intent for observation.

Trade results show verified readable amounts and actual proceeds when receipt evidence is available, with estimates identified separately. Provider content completes the original task even while payment observation is pending. Exact raw evidence remains available. Sell accepts the dollar value you want to sell or a token amount; expected and actual proceeds remain distinct. Governed Send is unavailable in this runtime. Wallet keys, signing material and login secrets stay out of the conversation.
